verdict.rationale: The only first-party hint of official SDKs is Stripe's own llms.txt telling readers to check npm for the latest version when installing Stripe packages, which implies official client packages exist. Nothing documents which languages are covered, their features, or their Billing API coverage. The Subscriptions API, CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and supported languages, SDK coverage of Billing APIs (subscriptions, meters, invoices), install and usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
